order_wins: **Bharat Dynamics** — signs a **Rs 810.79 crore Ministry of Defence contract for Satellite Smart Anti-Airfield Weapons for the Indian Air Force**, a DRDO design with 60% indigenous content, for delivery in 2027-28 and 2028-29 _(~1.9% of mcap)_.

**Skipper** — secures **Rs 797 crore of transmission and distribution orders**, export orders for towers and monopoles in Australia plus a domestic 765 kV line from an unnamed developer _(~12.6% of mcap)_.

**Oswal Pumps** — receives a **Letter of Intent from Telangana Renewable Energy Development Corporation for 46,705 kW of rooftop solar across 9,937 government schools**, Rs 297.50 crore including GST, Rs 273.19 crore excluding _(~9.5% of mcap)_.

**Avantel** — receives a **firm Rs 177.35 crore purchase order including taxes from Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses for satellite communication equipment**, to be executed by March 2027 _(~4.6% of mcap)_.
**Vikran Engineering** — wins a **Rs 153.76 crore POWERGRID award excluding GST for the 400 kV Tumkur-II AIS substation extension**, including STATCOM civil works, over 21 months _(~9.8% of mcap)_.
**Indo Tech Transformers** — receives a **Rs 42.88 crore Letter of Award plus GST from Leap Green Energy Group for four 125 MVA transformers** for a solar and a wind project _(~1.2% of mcap)_.
**One Point One Solutions** — secures a **Rs 39.32 crore customer-experience mandate from an unnamed leading power utility**, run from its Navi Mumbai and Indore delivery centres _(~1.9% of mcap)_.
**Suntech Infra Solutions** — receives a **Rs 37.00 crore piling work order from a domestic company it does not name**, to be executed over nine months _(~50.4% of mcap)_.

**Tuni Textile Mills** — receives **three orders for 1.975 million metres of shirting from Disha Clothings, Northakross Syntex and Sharda Corporation**, Rs 29.51-30.17 crore excluding GST, about 98.75% of annual capacity _(~30.6% of mcap)_.

**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** — receives a **Rs 20.02 crore Letter of Award for 57 wind-turbine transformers for Aditya Birla Renewables' Bhuj projects** from an unnamed EPC contractor _(~15.2% of mcap)_.

**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** — separately reports **Rs 5.28 crore of purchase orders taken since 14 September**, the largest Rs 4.48 crore of inverter-duty transformers for Good Earth Renewable Services _(~4.0% of mcap)_.

**Yaan Enterprises** — receives a **Rs 15.86 crore purchase order for yellow maize from the State Agri Horticultural Development Co-operative Society, Thiruvananthapuram**, to supply within two months _(~38.1% of mcap)_.

**Rajputana Biodiesel** — with subsidiary Nirvaanraj Energy **receives Hindustan Petroleum Letters of Intent for 740 kilolitres of biodiesel each at Jaipur and Meerut**, about Rs 13.72 crore including GST _(~9.8% of mcap)_.
**Sheetal Universal** — receives a **USD 1.22 million export order from Beacon Star General Trading, Dubai, for 1,000 tonnes of peanut kernel**, about Rs 11.53 crore per the filing _(~2.7% of mcap)_.
**Subex** — is **chosen by a major Asia-Pacific mobile operator to consolidate its wholesale partner settlement onto one platform**, USD 5 million over five years, extendable by two.
**BCPL Railway Infrastructure** — bags a **Rs 6.22 crore Letter of Acceptance from Eastern Railway's Howrah division to replace overaged cantilever assemblies**, over 18 months _(~5.4% of mcap)_.
**Euphoria Infotech** — receives a **Rs 4.03 crore Webel Technology work order to run West Bengal's undergraduate admission portal** for 2026-27, over seven months _(~50% of mcap)_.
**Dhruv Consultancy Services** — receives a **Rs 3.79 crore Letter of Award from Maharashtra PWD, Panvel**, for a feasibility report on widening 249.20 km of roads, over 365 days _(~9.5% of mcap)_.
**Desco Infratech** — receives a **Rs 2.34 crore purchase order including GST from Adani Total Gas** for MDPE pipeline laying at Navsari _(~1.6% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Bharat Forge** — allots **1,05,82,010 shares at Rs 1,890 in its qualified institutions placement, aggregating Rs 20,000 million**, a 2.96% discount to the floor; the issue ran 17-22 September _(~2.1% of mcap)_.

**Prime Focus** — board approves **Multiples Private Equity investing USD 100 million in subsidiaries Brahma AI Holdings and Brahma AI Services India** through convertible preference shares, subject to shareholder approval.

**Simplex Castings** — board approves **44,90,791 shares to non-promoter investors and 50,05,195 warrants at Rs 105, Rs 47.15 crore plus Rs 52.55 crore**, subject to an EGM on 15 October _(~17.8% of mcap, our sum)_.

**Prime Focus** — its press release puts **Brahma AI's Multiples-led equity raise at USD 150 million at a USD 2 billion post-money valuation**, against USD 100 million in the board outcome, with USD 100 million more demand under evaluation.
**Oscar Global** — board approves a **Rs 13.21 crore cash preferential issue of 1,32,06,400 shares at Rs 10 to Alok Rajesh Nanavaty and Pie Strategies LLP**, put to an EGM on 20 October.
**Healthy Life Agritec** — board approves **raising up to Rs 50 crore through a rights issue of partly paid shares**; price, ratio and record date are still to be set.
**Party Cruisers** — **trims its rights issue to 19,98,318 shares and Rs 23.98 crore** by corrigendum, now opening 29 September and closing 13 October _(~20.3% of mcap)_.
**Ola Electric Mobility** — says it is **seeking board approval for a proposed rights issue of equity shares**, open to retail, institutional and promoter-group holders; no size is stated.
**Bajaj Finance** — calls a **board meeting on 1 October to consider raising funds by preferential issue or qualified institutions placement**, subject to shareholder approval; no size is stated.
**Aegis Logistics** — calls a **board meeting on 28 September to consider raising funds through equity, convertible bonds, depository receipts or other instruments**.
**Swaraj Suiting** — calls a **board meeting on 28 September to consider a preferential issue of equity shares and warrants**.
**Kellton Tech Solutions** — board approves **a rights issue of Re 1 equity shares**; size, price, ratio and record date are left to be decided.
**ACE Software Exports** — confirms **first-call money of Rs 30.25 a share on 50,36,721 partly paid rights shares**, about Rs 15.24 crore on our arithmetic.
**California Software** — **extends to 9 October the first and final call of Rs 7.50 a share on partly paid rights shares**, other terms unchanged.
equity_allotments: **Jaykay Enterprises** — allots **2,05,71,642 partly paid rights shares at Rs 75, three for every 19 held**, about Rs 154.29 crore once fully paid on our arithmetic; new shares _(~5.3% of mcap)_.
**Kirloskar Electric** — allots **34,68,007 new shares at Rs 115.34, Rs 40.00 crore, to promoter-group Kirloskar Power Equipments**, lifting its holding to 6.60% from 1.73% _(~5.0% of mcap)_.
**Kalyani Cast-Tech** — allots **3,23,123 new convertible warrants at Rs 582, Rs 18.81 crore**, with Rs 4.70 crore received upfront _(~2.1% of mcap)_.

**Remi Edelstahl Tubulars** — allots **8,33,331 new shares at Rs 180, Rs 15.00 crore, to promoter-group Hanuman Freight and Skyrise Mercantile and three others**; its warrants were not issued _(~4.5% of mcap)_.
**PC Jeweller** — allots **1,18,52,500 shares to managing director Balram Garg on converting past warrants**, against the balance Rs 16.00 crore of the issue price.
**Aurique** — allots **98,38,200 new convertible warrants at Rs 12 to Vandanaben Patel of the promoter group and Sureshkumar Patel**, with 25% received upfront.
**Ken Enterprises** — **adds promoter-group Zest Performancewear as proposed allottee of 39,94,000 of 39,97,000 warrants** in its Rs 16.19 crore issue approved on 5 September.
**Qualitek Labs** — **substitutes Jagattaraini Tieup for Vibha Singhi as proposed allottee of 16,000 shares** in the issue approved on 22 September; other terms unchanged.
m_and_a: **Quality Power Electrical Equipments** — signs a **share purchase agreement for up to 100% of Winwin Speciality Insulators, up to Rs 272.34 crore**, in swap shares at Rs 1,460 and up to Rs 123.84 crore cash, subject to a 19 October EGM.

**Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals** — agrees to **buy Group Pharmaceuticals' wellness portfolio by slump sale for Rs 23.7 crore plus up to Rs 23.0 crore of FY28-linked earn-out**, capped at Rs 46.7 crore _(~3.1% of mcap)_.

**Euro Pratik Sales** — board approves **a 56% controlling stake in Fabwood Solutions, owner-to-be of the Fab Wood business, for Rs 42.70 crore** including Rs 8.40 crore of fresh capital _(~1.9% of mcap)_.

**Hemo Organic** — promoters **agree to sell 5,67,958 shares, 16.38% of the company, to Ketanaben Jasani, Heema Makadia, V9BIZ Business Solution and Jasani Family Trust**; consideration not disclosed.

**Apollo Micro Systems** — the **CCI holds its acquisition of Premier Explosives is not a notifiable combination**, so no approval is needed and the open offer to Premier's public shareholders proceeds.
**Power Grid Corporation** — **acquires project SPV Barmer HVDC Power Transmission from RECPDCL** after winning the bid, for 6,000 MW of 800 kV HVDC terminals and a roughly 1,000 km bipole line.
**REC** — subsidiary RECPDCL **transfers Barmer HVDC Power Transmission to Power Grid and Sakoli Power Transmission to Ashoka Buildcon**, the successful tariff-based bidders.
**Ashoka Buildcon** — **acquires 100% of transmission SPV Sakoli Power Transmission from RECPDCL for Rs 3.06 crore**, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.
**Oscar Global** — board approves **buying 100% of Calculus Travel Ventures from JBCG Advisory Services for 3,45,10,000 swap shares at Rs 10, Rs 34.51 crore**.
**D & H India** — agrees to **buy 70,094 sq m of leasehold industrial land at Mohana, Indore, from DP Polymers & Chemicals for Rs 18.00 crore** for expansion _(~9.3% of mcap)_.
**Mukta Arts** — signs agreements under which **Sunil Shamrao Patil will invest up to Rs 10 crore in subsidiary Mukta A2 Cinemas**, cutting Mukta Arts to 42-49% and making it an associate.
**Acetech E-Commerce** — signs an **asset purchase agreement for the Neora-Store lighting and home-decor e-commerce brand from a Sharjah company for USD 1.8 million**.
**IRB InvIT Fund** — **executes the purchase of 100% of Solapur Yedeshi Tollway and CG Tollway from sponsor-linked IRB Infrastructure Trust**, a related-party deal unitholders approved on 3 August.
**Waaree Energies** — board approves the **draft scheme amalgamating Indosolar into Waaree Energies**, subject to the exchanges, the NCLT and both companies' shareholders and creditors.
**Ravindra Energy** — board approves the **scheme amalgamating Energy In Motion into Ravindra Energy**, subject to the exchanges, SEBI, the NCLT and shareholders.
**Pitti Engineering** — its **scheme amalgamating Pitti Industries and Dakshin Foundry becomes effective on 23 September** on filing with the RoC, with an appointed date of 1 April 2026.
**Baron Infotech** — its **first board after the NCLT-approved resolution plan takes on record the amalgamation of PurpleTalk India** under that plan and seats a new board.
**Mason Infratech** — the monitoring committee **approves allotting Sabve Rohini Contractors' shares to it under the approved resolution plan**; closure awaits payment of the bid value.
**Lemon Tree Hotels** — receives **no-objection letters from both exchanges for its composite scheme folding in Fleur Hotels, Carnation, Hamstede Living and four other group companies**.

**Niyogin Fintech** — the **NCLT Chennai allows the first-motion application for its demerger into Niyogin Finserv and amalgamation of iServeU Technology**, directing shareholder and creditor meetings.
capex_core: **UltraTech Cement** — **commissions 4.6 mtpa of cement capacity**, a 3.6 mtpa greenfield plant at Petnikota, Andhra Pradesh plus 1.0 mtpa of debottlenecking, taking domestic grey cement capacity to 204.7 mtpa.
**Exide Industries** — subsidiary Exide Energy Solutions **completes commissioning of a 6 GWh lithium-ion cell plant at Devanahalli, Bengaluru**, for mobility and energy-storage chemistries.
**Websol Energy System** — **West Bengal allots it 54.20 acres at Falta for a planned 4 GW solar cell and 4 GW module plant**, to be built in two 2 GW phases.
**Prostarm Info Systems** — finishes installation and trials and **starts its 1.2 GWh battery-storage plant at Jhajjar and relocated UPS and lithium-battery operations at Bakrol on 25 September**.

**Maxvolt Energy Industries** — breaks ground on a **proposed 10 GWh lithium battery-pack campus at Aligarh, sized at Rs 700 crore across two 5 GWh phases** in its event material; the first phase is 24-30 months out.
**Wonder Electricals** — board approves **buying Onkar Engine and Generator's geyser plant, excluding land, for about Rs 16.50 crore plus tax**, adding 20% to monthly capacity _(~1.6% of mcap)_.
**Orient Green Power** — subsidiary Delta Renewable Energy **commissions 17.60 MW AC of solar in Tiruvannamalai**, taking installed solar to 24.6 MW AC.
business_updates: **Results season** — 30 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Max Estates** — signs a **binding MoU for a joint development of 9.76 acres in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad**, envisaging 1.5 million sq ft and a projected development value of Rs 2,500-3,000 crore, subject to due diligence and the JDA.

**GHCL** — is **declared preferred bidder for a composite licence over the Kadaya limestone block, Junagadh**, with 5,67,337 tonnes of reserve; the Letter of Intent follows only on performance security.
**Raymond** — subsidiary JK Maini Global Aerospace **wins a tender to assemble wing and centre-fuselage structures for an indigenous fighter programme**; no value is disclosed.

**GMR Airports** — subsidiary GMR Hospitality is **selected to run Delhi Terminal 3 food and beverage outlets to May 2036** for fellow subsidiary DIAL, a related-party deal it estimates at Rs 49 crore of FY27 licence fees.
**PC Jeweller** — **repays a 13th of its 14 consortium banks**, discharging more than 99% of bank debt under its 2024 settlement, and targets debt-free status this month.
**Chandan Healthcare** — says its **diagnostic franchise network has passed 500 of 568 centres** and targets 1,000 by the end of FY27.

**Awfis Space Solutions** — opens an **Elite centre of about 1,00,000 sq ft of chargeable area at Prestige Trade Centre, Aerocity**, aimed at GCCs and enterprises, taking its premium portfolio to 37 centres.
**Borosil** — **pushes commercial production of the third double-wall line at subsidiary Stylenest to January 2027** from Q2 FY27, citing delays in imported Chinese equipment.
**Glenmark Pharmaceuticals** — receives the **US FDA inspection report for its Goa plant with Voluntary Action Indicated status**, closing out the June inspection.
credit_rating_changes: **Vadilal Enterprises** — **India Ratings downgrades it to IND A- from IND A+ long term and A2+ from A1+ short term**, and places both on Rating Watch Negative.
**Vadilal Industries** — **India Ratings places its IND A+ and A1+ ratings on Rating Watch with Negative Implications**.
**PNC Infratech** — **CARE places its AA+ long-term rating on Rs 1,700 crore of bank facilities, and its A1+ short-term rating, on Rating Watch with Negative Implications**.
**Salasar Techno Engineering** — **Infomerics places its IVR A and A1 ratings on Watch with Negative Implications** across Rs 831.73 crore of facilities.
**Oswal Pumps** — **ICRA revises its A+ outlook to Negative from Stable**, citing a receivables build-up and weaker profitability.
**Steel Exchange India** — **Infomerics upgrades its debentures and long-term facilities to IVR BBB+/Stable from BBB-** and the short-term rating to A2 from A3.
**JSW Infrastructure** — **CARE upgrades subsidiary JSW Jaigarh Port to AA+/Stable from AA/Stable** on Rs 600 crore of long-term facilities.

**Ashika Global Securities** — **CARE upgrades material subsidiary Ashika Stock Services to CARE A-/Stable and A1** on Rs 200 crore long-term, Rs 300 crore short-term and Rs 100 crore of commercial paper.
**JSW Infrastructure** — **CARE upgrades subsidiary JSW Dharamtar Port to AA+/Stable from AA/Stable** and assigns AA+ to a new Rs 400 crore long-term bank facility.
**SBFC Finance** — **CARE revises its AA- outlook to Positive from Stable** on Rs 6,000 crore of bank facilities, enhanced from Rs 2,500 crore.
distress_risk: **Sapphire Foods India** — receives a **Tamil Nadu GST show-cause notice of INR 5,168.38 million for FY24 input-credit claims**, which it calls not maintainable and says contains computational errors.
**Sasken Technologies** — the **GST appellate authority dismisses its FY21 and FY22 appeals**, confirming Rs 14.45 crore and Rs 10.90 crore of reverse-charge demands with interest.

**IRCON International** — the **arbitration on AFCONS' Rs 359.72 crore claim closes with a June majority award of Rs 147.14 crore** and a minority dissent of Rs 23.64 crore filed today; IRCON will challenge it in the Delhi High Court.
**Vikran Engineering** — receives a **Bihar GST demand-cum-show-cause notice for FY23 of Rs 5.34 crore of tax plus Rs 0.53 crore of penalty**.
**Shriram Finance** — receives **CGST penalty orders for FY21-FY23 on the erstwhile Shriram City Union Finance**, about Rs 5.59 crore across six orders on our sum.
**NIS Management** — moves the **Calcutta High Court against ESIC notices seeking Rs 2.17 crore of damages**, which it calls unsustainable.
**Solarworld Energy Solutions** — the **Uttarakhand GST appellate authority sets aside a Rs 1.22 crore penalty on subsidiary ZNShine Solarworld**, allowing its appeal.
**Supriya Lifescience** — a court **allows provisional release of a detained 200 kg ketamine consignment against a Rs 72 lakh deposit**, with NDPS proceedings continuing.
open_offers: **Oscar Global Ltd** — JBCG Advisory Services Private Limited open offer (18.37 lakh shares) at Rs 10 vs CMP 22.68 (-55.9%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); intends to DELIST; **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 7 cr
other_notable: **Procter & Gamble Hygiene and Health Care** — **denies rumours of a potential delisting or winding up** as baseless, after a material price movement.
**Motilal Oswal Financial Services** — subsidiary Motilal Oswal Custodial Services **receives SEBI approval to act as a custodian of securities**.
**Aeroflex Neu** — board decides to **enter AI infrastructure and precision engineering products** and to redirect its approved preferential-issue proceeds there, subject to a 22 October EGM.
**ICICI Prudential Life Insurance** — the Registrar of Companies **approves its renaming to ICICI Life Insurance Limited** from 22 September; IRDAI is next.
